tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i ṭīk+ka bzhugs/

rje btsun mi pham mgon po la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnyis pa lam shes tshig don yan lag gi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la/ skabs 'dir lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang*/ gzhu don dngos bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ skabs dang por rnam mkhyen bshad zin pa'i 'og tu lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyen thob pa la lam shes bsgom pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang 'grel ba'i mtshams sbyar du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtogs pa ni lam shes pa nyid yongs su shes pa med na med pas lam shes pa nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lam shes kyi yan lag bshad pa dang*/ de'i rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis/ rtsa ba las/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi rkang ba bzhi gsungs*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ khyab pa'i don bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ngag tu bsgril na/ shes bya chos can/ yum gyi mdo las lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su bab pa na de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i 'od mog mog por mdzad nas zil gyis mnan pa la dgos pa yod de/ lha de rnams kyi nga rgyal bcom nas rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed dang lam shes skye rung bar bya ba'i phyir du yin pa'i phyir/ lam shes skye ba'i rten gyi yul nges pa yin te/ lam gsum rdzogs par bsgom pa'i lam la mkhas pa la ni/ de'i sngon du rigs can gsum ka'i don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi rten nges par dgos pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpar ma zad/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la lam shes skye rung ba yin te/ de thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi 'jig rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ lam shes chos can/ nyan rang gi lam las rang bzhin gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/

nyan rang ltar nyon mongs gtso bor mi spong bar nyon mongs 'ga' zhig gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur bar byed nus pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ nyan rang gi lam las lam shes de'i byed las kyang khyad par du 'phags te/ dus ma yin par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed cing*/ sems can mtha' yas pa smin cing grol bar byed nus pa'i byed las can yin pa'i phyir/ bsdu na 'dir bstan pa'i lam shes kyi yan lag de la lnga yod de/ der gyur pa'i gegs mngon pa'i nga rgyal mngon 'gyur ba dang bral ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ rten rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pa/ nyon mongs gtso bor mi spong pa'i rang bzhin/ sems can smin cing grol bar byed nus pa'i byed las dang lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ khyab pa'i don bshad pa dang*/ rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dir khyab pa'i don yod de/ 'grel pa las/ theg pa gsum rnam par gzhag pa ni dgongs pa can yin gyi/ mtshan nyid pa ni ma yin no zhes lugs las 'byung bas/ skye bo thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug pa can yin te/ zhes pa nas/ lam shes pa nyid bsgom par bya bas khyab pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyis khyab pas/ lam shes bsgom par byar rung bas khyab pa/ de la brten nas kyang mthar 'tshang rgya bas kyang khyab pa ni khyab pa'i don yin pas khyab pa rnam pa gsum ga yang 'dir bstan pa'i phyir/ de ltar na'ang mthar thug theg pa gsum bstan pa'i mdo dang mi 'gal te/ dgongs gzhi/ dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel ba'i phyir/ dgongs gzhi yod de/ gnas skabs rigs gsum so sor nges pa yod pa la dgongs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ dang po nas theg chen du 'jug pa 'dod pa 'ga' zhig rim gyis dkri ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/

dngos la gnod byed yod de/ lung du ma dang*/ rig pa du mas gnod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ dam chos pad dkar dang*/ dpal 'phreng gi mdo la sogs pa'i lung du mas gnod pa'i phyir/ rigs pas gnod pa'i tshul mthar thug pa yang*/ sems can thams cad kyi sems don dam par rang bzhin gyis med cing*/ dri ma rnams glo bur pa sems rgyud la 'bral rung du gnas pa la nges pa thob dgos pa yin te/ de'i tshul rgyas par ni rgyud bla ma rtsa 'grel las bshad pa ltar shes dgos shing*/ bsdu na kun byang gi chos thams cad tha snyad du yod kyang*/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yang dag gis dpyad cing btsal na btags don mi rnyed pas/ chags sogs nyon mongs gzhan thams cad kyi rtsa ba bden 'dzin de nyid zhen yul la 'khrul bar rtogs pas spong nus su 'grub pa'i phyir/ de yang yin te/ nyon mongs kyi rtsa ba bden 'dzin de/ thag khra la sbrul 'dzin gyi blo ltar 'khrul bar nges stobs kyis/ des bskyed pa'i nyon mongs gzhan thams cad kyang glo bur ba yin par nges nus la/ de la brten nas gnyen po bsgoms na chags sogs kyi nyon mongs thams cad kyang spong nus su go bas/ mthar sgrib pa thams cad spangs ba'i sangs rgyas thob nus su shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der ma zad*/ rigs pa des 'khor ba la thog ma med kyang phyi mtha' yod par yang nges nus te/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba las/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rigs yod pa'i phyir 'ga' yang gtan rnam par dag par mi 'gyur ba ni 'os pa ma yin te/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rtag pa'i chos can phyir/ /thog med sbubs kyis phyis sgrib mi mthong ste/ /ji ltar gser gyi gzugs ni sgrib pa bzhin/ /zhes dang*/ bzhi brgya pa las/ ji lta sa bon mtha' mthong zhing*/ /de la thog ma yod min ltar/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de bzhin du rgyan snang*/

rnam 'grel sogs las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de rnams 'dir mtshon tsam zhig bstan gyi/ rgyas par ni gzhung gzhan dang kho bos kyang phar phyin gyi skabs gnyis par bshad zin pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpas nyon mongs gtso bor mi spong ba'i sgo nas nyan rang gi lam las rang bzhin gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan du/ nyon mongs 'ga' zhig gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur ba byed par 'god na/ nyon mongs de gang yin zhe na/ yod de/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags/ gzugs kyi sas bsdus kyi nyon mongs 'ga' zhig byang chub sems dpas gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur bar byed dgos pas spang bya'i gtso bor byas nas mi spong pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byang 'phags 'khor lo sgyur rgyal lta bur skye ba blangs nas sras bskrun te gzhan don byed pa'i yan lag tu 'dod pa'i 'dod chags nges bar dgos shing*/ gzugs khams su skye ba blangs nas de rnams kyi don byed pa la gzugs kyi 'dod chags yan lag tu sgyur bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang thun mong du grags tshul kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ byang 'phags skye ba blangs nas sras bskrun te gzhan don byed pa'i yan lag tu 'dod chags nges par dgos pa min te/ skye ba la dbang thob pa'i byang 'phags nyon mongs spangs pa 'ga' zhig 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal lta bur skye ba blangs nas yum sras kyi 'brel ba ston pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po gzhon nu don grub dang*/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po bzhin/ gzhan yang de ltar yod de/ rje'i rim lnga gsal sgron las de med par 'dod pa la dgag pa mdzad nas yod par lung rigs gnyis kyis bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi rang bzhin bshad pa la/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/

dang po la/ ngo bo bshad pa dang*/ rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ / zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ ngag don ni/ lam shes rdzogs par sgom pa nyid kyi tshul la ni nyan thos kyi lam 'di chos can/ khyod ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul shes par bya ba yod de/ sdug bden la sogs pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag gi rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang*/ sems bskyed dang*/ rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo ba gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas sgom par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ de'i don bsdu na 'di ltar yin te/ nyan thos rnams kyis mi rtag la sogs bcu drug bsgoms nas thar ba thob par mdzad la/ byang 'phags kyis kyang gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs sbyong ba'i ched du sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi sgom tshul de dang tshul mthun par mi rtag la sogs bcu drug sgom par mdzad pa'i mkhyen pa de la nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa'i phyir/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'dir bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug nyams su len pa'i tshul yan mang du gsungs pas bcu drug gi nges 'dzin tsam zhig kyang shes pa gal che ste/ de yang sdug bden nyer len gyi phung po la ni skye 'jig gi mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa dang bdag med pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang*/ kun 'byung las nyon gnyis la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pa dang*/ kun nas 'byung ba dang rab tu skye ba dang rkyen gyi rnam pa bzhi dang*/ 'gog pa nyon mongs spangs pa'i bral ba la ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa dang zhi ba dang gya nom pa dang nges par 'byung pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang*/ sa lam bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes la ni thar lam dang rig pa dang sgrub pa dang nges 'byin gyi bzhi rnam pa bzhi ste bcu drug tu 'byed pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ /zhes pa nas/ mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi lam mngon sum du shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu la ni sbyor lam drod la sogs pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi yod de/ de yang yum kyi mdo las gzugs la sogs pa don dam par rang gi ngo bos stong ba'i phyir na de dag gi stong ba nyid rnams ngo bo dbyer med par bstan pa'i gzhung gis bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam dro ba dang*/ gzugs sogs de dag don dam par mi dmigs shing mi gnas par bstan pas bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs sogs de dag la don dam par rtag pa dang mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bkag cing mi gnas par bstan pas bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa rnams dang*/ sa dang po sogs la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas par mi bya'o zhes sogs kyi mdo las sa bcu po dag las brtsams nas don dam par mi gnas pa'i tshul rgyas par bstan pa yis mdo las bshad pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos kyi mchog tu gyur pa dang bzhi bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar bshad pa ci phyir zhe na yod de/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos nyid mngon sum du mkhyen nas chos rnams don dam par gnas par ma gzigs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo tshig 'dir lam shes de'i rgyud nges 'byed cha 'thun la stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin dgos par bstan gyi stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab ste/ de nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang 'dra bar nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la/ lam bgrod pa'i khyad par/ chos ston tshul/ lam ji ltar shes tshul/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun bshad pa dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa nas/ zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ rang byung ste rang rgyal dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod kyis srid pa tha ma'i tshe rang gi byang chub mngon du byed par slob dpon gzhan gyis gdams ngag bstan pa la bltos mi dgos te/ de'i tshe de la mi bltos par bdag nyid kyis byang chub rtogs pa ste mngon du byed nus pa'i phyir/ yang zhes smos pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ de'i tshe ngag gis gzhan la chos mi ston par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bse ru lta bu'i ye shes de ni chos can/ nyan thos las rtogs pa zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod pa yin te/ nyan thos ltar chos ston pa'i ngag gi 'bras rtags las rtogs mi dgos shing*/ sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos ston pa'i rtogs pa zab mo dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'dir bse ru lta bu zhes smros pa ni phyogs gcig gi sgras bstan pa yin gyi/ rang rgyal yin na/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal yin pas ma khyab ste/ rang rgyal la bse ru lta bu dang tshogs spyod che chung gi rang rgyal gsum yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal slob pa yin na/ rang gi byang chub mngon du byed nges yin pas ma khyab ste/ tshogs spyod che chung gi rang rgyal rigs ma nges pa bar skabs su theg chen lam du 'jug pa yod pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal gyis sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos ston pa mang yang*/ sgra med du chos ston pas ma khyab ste/ tshogs spyod kyi rang rgyal la sgra bcas su chos ston pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa chos ston tshul ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs*/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang rgyal gyis sgra med kyang chos ston pa mi 'gal te/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya gang dang gang yin pa des rtogs bya'i don ni gang dang gang la rnam pa ji lta ji ltar nyan par 'dod pa de dang de la don de dang de bshad pa de ltar snang bar byed nus pa'i phyir/

gsum pa lam ji ltar shes tshul ni/ gzung don rtogs pa spong phyir dang*/ zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ bse ru lta bu'i lam de ni chos can/ khyad chos gsum dang ldan pas yang dag par bsdus par shes par bya ste/ gzung ba gzugs sogs phyi rol don du 'dzin pa'i rtog ba gtso bor spong ba'i phyir dang*/ gzugs 'dzin shes pa sogs nang 'dzin pa la bden par zhen pa gtso bor mi spong ba'i phyir dang ni/ rang rgyal gyi rigs la brten pa'i rten gyi khyad par gyi sgo nas shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzhung 'dis rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyang bstan pa yin te/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshul gyis tshig gi zur la bstan pa'i phyir te/ byang 'phags kyis gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir du don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong bar byed pa'i rang gi ye shes rang rgyal gyi lam shes su bstan pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang rang rgyal gyis nang shes pa bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gtso bor mi spong ba ltar byang 'phags kyis ma yin te/ byang sems kyis bden 'dzin lhan skyes thams cad gtso bor spong dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ zhes pa nas/ rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun la bzhi yod de/ phyi don med par rtogs kyang brdar btags pa'i chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar chos ston pa'i rnam pa can gyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam dro bar gyur pa dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa phyi rol don du 'grib pa med par rtogs pa las sogs pas phye ba'i sbyor lam rtse mor gyur pa dang*/ nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa rtogs pa'i mthu yis gzugs sogs phyi rol don gyi ched du mi 'dzin pa'i phyir du zhugs pa'i sbyor lam bzod pa dang*/

gzugs sogs phyi rol don du skye ba med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos kyi mchog ces bya ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gzhung 'dis rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyur bstan pa yin te/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas phyi don med par rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod sogs bzhi lam shes de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun du bstan par 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/ rnam bshad ltar na de ltar yin yang*/ 'grel ba'i tshig ris la zin byed kyi sbyor lam bzhi dngos su bstan par bshad do/ /gsum pa byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes 'chad pa la/ mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*/ / zhes pa nas/ phan yon bcas pa 'di bshad do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes nyid kyi skabs la mthong ba'i lam phan yon dang bcas pa 'di bshad par bya ste/ sdug kun gyi bden pa dang 'gog lam gyi bden pa bzhi la bzod pa dang shes pa'i skad cig ma rnam pa bzhi bzhi yi sgo nas bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag / zhes pa nas/ /lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs / don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi mthong lam la shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod de/ don dam bar sdug bden gyi de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas te de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can gyi ye shes dag phan tshun rten dang brten pa med pa'i phyir don dam par rten brten pa'i rnam grangs khas mi len zhing len pa med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ gzugs sogs kyi chos dbyings rgya chen por rgyur pa don dam par med par rtogs pa'i ye shes sdug bsngal chos shes dang*/

sdug bsngal don dam par 'jal pa'i tshad ma dang bcas pa med par rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal rjes bzod dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi tshad don dam par med bar rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal rjes shes dang*/ kun 'byung don dam par mtha' med par rtogs pa'i kun 'byung chos bzod dang*/ chos bzod der gnas nas gzugs la sogs pa la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin bden stong nyid du nges par 'dzin pa'i kun 'byung chos shes dang*/ don dam par blang bar bya ba med cing dor med pa sogs su rtogs pa'i kun 'byung rjes bzod dang*/ byams pa la sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i kun 'byung rjes shes dang*/ 'gog pa'i rang bzhin stong ba nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'gog pa chos bzod dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob par byed pa'i 'gog pa chos shes dang*/ rnam par byang pa'i rigs kun yongs su bsdus pa'i 'gog pa rjes bzod dang*/ phyi'i 'tshe ba nyam nga ba dang nang gi kun sel bar byed pa'i 'gog pa rjes shes dang*/ lam bden gyi thob bya mthar thug gi mya ngan las 'das pa ni bden 'dzin gyi spros pa zhi ba'i bden stong nyid du rtogs pa'i lam rjes bzod dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis rang nyid la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa srung ba la sogs par byed pa'i lam chos shes dang*/ srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa'i dge bcu rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa'i tshul la ni bdag nyid kyang gnas te/ sems can gzhan dag 'god par byed pa'i lam rjes bzod dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa phyin drug gi dge rtsa rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar byed pa'i lam rjes shes dang bcas pa lam shes pa nyid kyi skabs su mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug ni ldog pa phye ba yin gyi/ bsdu na bzod shes gnyis su 'du ste/ theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam la bzod pa brgyad dang*/

rnam grol lam la shes pa brgyad du phye bas de gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir/ bzod shes gnyis las bzod pa brgyad sngon du skye zhing*/ shes pa brgyad rjes su skye ba yin te/ mthong lam bar chad med lam sngon du skyes nas rnam grol lam rjes su skye ba'i phyir/ des na bzod pa brgyad cig car dang*/ shes pa brgyad cig car du skye yang brgyad kyi tha snyad byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bden bzhi'i chos nyid dang de rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi chos nyid gzigs tshul gyi sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir te/ sdug bsngal chos bzod dang rjes bzod/ de bzhin du kun 'byung*/ 'gog pa/ lam la'ang sbyar te/ bzod pa brgyad dang*/ sdug bsngal chos shes dang rjes shes dang de bzhin du gzhan gsum la sbyar bas shes pa brgyad du 'jog pa'i phyir te/ yul bden bzhi'i chos nyid gsar du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas chos bzod dang*/ yul can chos bzod bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes bzod du 'jog la/ bden 'dzin kun btags spangs pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas chos shes dang*/ chos shes kyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rjes shes su 'jog pa yin pa'i phyi/ bzod pa dang shes pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa na bya byed kyi rnam gzhag 'jig pa ltar 'gyur bas skrag rigs pa las mi skrag pas skye med la bzod pa dang*/ bden 'dzin kun btags spangs pa'i 'gog pa mngon du byas pa'i cha nas chos nyid mngon sum du shes pas shes pa zhes brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir mthong lam mnyam gzhag ye shes dngos su bstan nas mthong lam rjes thob ye shes don gyis 'phangs pa yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam thams cad ston pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sgom lam bshad pa la/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/

byed pa can gyi sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ /ces pa'i bar rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa de la drug yod de/ byang sems sgom lam pa thugs khengs pa'i nga rgyal sogs kun nas zhi ba dang*/ de'i mthus dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la 'dud pa dang*/ nyon mongs ci rigs pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang*/ pha rol gyi gnod pas brdzi ba med pa nyid dang bcas pa'i skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu bzhi dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nas chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gcig dang*/ rten sgom lam pa rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de gzhan gyis mchod pa'i gnas nyid du 'gyur pa'i bdag po'i 'bras bu gcig dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir byed pa'i don ni theg chen sgom lam bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa dang thob 'gyur gyi phan yod la byed pa yin zhing*/ de yang 'di'i dngos bstan ni theg chen gyi sgom lam rang rgyud la skyes ba zhig gis de bsgoms pa'i phan yon yin la/ theg chen sgom lam mos pa yid byed kyis sgom pa dang de bsgoms pa'i phan yon tsam la ni sgom lam thob pas ma khyab ste/ lam ma zhugs na de sgom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de na rnam mkhyen sgom pa yod pa'i phyir te/ de na sangs rgyas kyi sku sgom par byed pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam/ zag med sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis / dang po la/ mos pa sgom lam/ bsngo ba sgom lam/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen gyi mos pa sgom lam chos can/ rnam pa gsum du shes par bya ste/ rang gi don gyi mos pa sgom lam dang*/ de bzhin rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don dang*/

gzhan don mos pa sgom lam dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gsum po de yang ni chos can/ khyod la dbye na so sor rnam pa gsum du yod de/ khyod re re la der gyur pa'i chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po mos pa sgom lam rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mos pa sgom lam chung 'bring chen po de yang chos can/ re re la'ang rnam pa gsum gsum du 'dod pa yin te/ chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs te chung ngu'i 'bring dang de'i chen po sogs kyi dbye ba yis de ltar du yod pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ bsdu na mos pa sgom lam de de la rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun du 'dod pa yin te/ sngar bshad pa ltar dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun du 'gyur ba de ltar na'i phyir/ gnyis pa phan yon ni/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rang don gzhan don gnyis don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni chos can/ de ltar mos pa'i byang sems sgom lam pa la sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bstod pa dang bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod de/ sngar ltar dgu tshan gsum gyis bstod bkur bsngags par bzhed pa'i phyir/ mos pa sgom lam la mos pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum po re re'ang don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches shing mos pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ sgom lam 'di gtso bo'i dbang du byas na rjes thob ye shes kyis bsdus te/ sngar ltar mos shing sgom pa ni rjes thob nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ mnyam gzhag yin pa yod kyang rtog bcas yin te/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pas bsdus pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir te/ 'dir rtog pa dang bcas pa'i sgom lam la ni zag bcas sgom lam zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsngo ba sgom lam ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /zhes pa nas/ bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do/

/zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can de yi byed pa ni bsngo ba gzhan las mchog yin te/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba rdzogs byang du sgyur bar byed pa'i khyad par tu byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam de chos can/ rnam pa bcu gnyis su 'gyur te/ ji skad bshad pa'i byed pa mchog dang ldan pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ bsngo bya'i rdzas la bden zhen 'gog pa'i dmigs med kyi rnam pa can gyi bsngo ba dang*/ gang gis bsngo bar byed pa'i phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi bsngo ba dang*/ bsngo ba po don dam par dben par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ rang dang sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin don dam par mi dmigs par dran pa'i spyod yul can gyis bsngo ba dang*/ phyin drug gi dge rtsa don dam par mi dmigs par bsngo ba'i thabs mkhas dang bcas pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ gang gis gang du gang bsngo ba'i 'khor gsum gyi bden zhen 'gog pa mtshan ma med pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ don dam par med kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes nas sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo ba'i sangs rgyas kyis rjes su yi rang ba'i bsngo ba dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgyur mi bsngo bas 'dod pa'i khams la sogs pa'i khams dang bcas pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ stong gsum gyi sems can rnams dge ba bcu la bkod pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam pa'i bsngo ba chung ngu dang*/ rgyun zhugs la dkod pa'i bsod nams 'bring dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi lam la bkod pa'i bsod nams chen po 'byung ba yi bsngo ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ de rnams las gang bsod nams lhag par che ba yod de/ phyi ma gzhan ni rnam pa gsum po de bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba sgom lam 'di ni dge rtsa bsngo tshul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa yin te/ dge rtsa rnams rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir/

'di yang rjes thob tu 'byung ba yin te/ bsngo smon gyi bya ba rjes thob tu mdzad dgos pa'i phyir/ byang sems sgoṃ laṃ pas rang rgyud kyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar nges kyang de kho nar bsngo ba min te/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde la 'god pa'i ched du bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan gyi dge rtsa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngo yang*/ de tsam gyis dge rtsa de rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i go chod par bzhag dka' ste/ gzhan du na nyan rang la sogs pa'i dge rtsa thams cad kyang rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i dge rtsa thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dge rtsa rnams rdzogs byang du bsngos pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ mi mdzad cing bsod nams rgya chen po 'byung ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thig lhung*/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rjes su yi rang sgom lam ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /zhes pa nas/ sgom pa yin par 'dir brjod do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud gyi rang gzhan kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa'i sgom lam chos can/ khyod rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa'i sgom pa'i lam yin par skabs 'dir brjod pa yin te/ dge rtsa rnams bden stong sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i thabs dang de rnams don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa dag gis rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang bar mdzad pa'i sgom lam chos can/ khyod rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam 'di yang rjes thob tu 'byung ba yin te/ rang gzhan gyis dge ba sgrubs pa'i tshul shes nas rjes su yi rang mdzad pa ni rjes thob nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba sogs bya ba bzang po gang la yang rjes su yi rang bar byas na phan yon chen po 'byung ba yin te/

sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang las gzhal bas tshad bzung rung*/ /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de ltar min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa zag med sgom lam bshad pa la/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ rnam dag sgom lam bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /zhes pa nas/ gtod par byed par don chen nyid/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ khyod la ldog pa'i sgo nas rnam pa lnga yod de/ gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam de yi ngo bo nyid dang*/ thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pa'i sbyin sogs kyi sangs rgyas mi 'thob cing thabs la mkhas pas de 'thob pa'i thabs kyi mchog nyid dang*/ chos thams cad bden med rtogs pas kun la bden par mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang*/ gnas skabs kyi byang chub khyad par can chos rnams dmigs su med par ni gtod par byed pa dang*/ mthar sangs thob par 'gyur bas don chen po nyid du byed pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam 'di dang*/ 'chad par 'gyur pa'i rnam dag sgom lam gnyis ka mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs su 'byung ba yin la/ 'di'i dngos bstan ni gtso bor stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i dbang du mdzad cing*/ spyir sgom lam de gnyis kas stong nyid rtogs pas ma khyab ste/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam de de gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam yin te/ gtso bor rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug sgrub byed kyi byang sems kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir rnam dag sgom lam yin te/ gtso bor spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed yin pa'i phyir te/ bdag 'dzin gnyis spangs pa'i spangs pa mthar thug sgrub byed pa'i ye shes khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/

'on kyang*/ de gnyis sgrub byed dang lag rjes 'jog byed kyi rigs su gnas pa ni min te/ de rtogs pa nyi tshe ba dang spangs pa nyi tshe ba'i lag rjes 'jog byed kyi rigs su gnas pa'i phyir te/ de rtogs rigs gnyis las theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ rgyu'i khyad par/ yul gyi khyad par/ 'bras bu'i khyad par/ ngo bo'i khyad par dang bzhi/ dang po/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs zin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ phy-i'i rkyen sangs rgyas kyis mtshon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ nang rkyen sbyin sogs dang bzhi lhag zung 'brel gyi thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa de chos can/ khyod rnam dag sgom lam 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin te/ de skye pa'i mthun rkyen khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ bdud gyis thibs kyis non pa'i gnod par byas pa dang*/ zab mo'i chos stong pa nyid la ma mos pa dang*/ phung po la sogs pa'i chos la bden par mngon par zhen pa dang*/ sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin pa rnams chos can/ khyod rnam dag sgom lam sogs chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyu dag yin te/ de skye ba'i gegs byed 'gal rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yul gyi khyad par ni/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ / zhes pa nas/ gcad du med par dag par brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ / don ni/ shes bya chos can/ dge sbyong tshul gyis 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa'i theg chen sgom lam rnam grol lam de rang 'dren byed bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na/ de'i dmigs yul gzugs la sogs pa yang bar chad med lam de'i ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa nyid yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na dag pa de gnyis dag bya gcig gis dben pa'i sgo nas ngo bo tha dad ma yin zhing*/ ldog pa yang rigs tha dad par gcad du med pas te de'i phyir/

de gnyis chos can/ rigs tha dad ma yin te/ rigs gcig par brjod pa'i phyir/ de yang cung zad phye na/ sa gnyis pa'i sgom lam rnam grol lam chos can/ khyod rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i tshe/ khyod kyi dmigs yul gzugs sogs kyang khyod 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal kyi dri mas rnam par dag pa yin te/ de'i tshe khyod rang nyid 'dren byed gy-i bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dag pa de dang*/ khyod kyi dmigs yul gzugs sogs khyod 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i dri mas rnam par dag pa'i dag pa de gnyis dag bya gcig gis dben pa'i dag pa rigs gcig yin pa'i phyir/ de'i don yang yod de/ sa gnyis pa'i sgom lam rnam grol lam lta bus rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma spangs nas/ rjes thob tu gzugs sogs kyi chos gang la dmigs kyang sngar spangs pa'i dri ma rnams slar skye mi rung du song bas de'i sgo nas rang dang dmigs yul gnyis dag par mtshungs pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'bras bu'i khyad par ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyis/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas rnam dag shin du ba/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ slob ma nyan thos kyi rnam dag yin te/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog bden chos can/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag yin te/ gzugs sogs phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags kyi 'gog bden chos can/ rgyal sras rnams kyi rnam par dag pa yin te/ nyan rang byang sems kyi lam gsum kyi sgrib pa ci rigs nyams shing spangs pa'i byang sems kyi bral ba yin pa'i phyir/

sangs rgyas kyi 'gog bden chos can/ rnam kun shin du ba'i dag pa yin te/ sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ rnam dag gi tha snyad de dag yum gyi mdo las gsungs pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ snga ma ni mdo las/ rab 'byor gzugs rnam pa dag pa gang yin pa de ni 'bras bu rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes pa nas de ltar na thams cad mkhyen nyid rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa gang yin pa 'di la gnyis su med cing gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi dad do/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ phyi ma ni/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug rnam par dag dang*/ zhes pa nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yongs su dag pa gang yin pa 'di la gnyis su byar med de tha mi dad cing ma chad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ngo bo'i khyad par la/ rnam dag shin tu yin min gyi khyad par dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin du bar bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes pa nas/ sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ rnam dag la shin du ba yin min gyi khyad par 'thad de/ sangs rgyas gyi rnam dag re ni 'dod pa dang bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi ste sa dgu la ni gtogs pa'i sgom spangs 'den 'dzin lhan skyes chen po yi chen po nas chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i dri ma rnams rim gy-is 'joms byed gnyen po theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam chung ngu'i chung ngu dang chung ngu'i 'bring la sogs pa'i lam ni rim kyis sbyangs stobs kyis dri ma de dag dag par byed pa'i rgyu byas pa'i sgo nas mthar thob pa'i rnam dag shin tu yin la/ nyan rang gi rnam dag ni tshul de ltar thob pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ del klan ka spangs pa yis/ zhes pa nas/

gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med rnams ni chos can/ khams gsum sa dgus bsdus pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po khyad par can nyid du 'dod pa yin te/ spang bya che rim nas 'gag cing gnyen po chung rim nas skye ba'i spang gnyen gyi rim pa de la gzhan gyis rtsod pa'i klan ka spangs pa yi sgo nas bya de rnams kyi gnyen por grub pa'i phyir/ de ltar grub ste/ dper na/ snang ba skye stobs kyis mun pa rim gyis sel ba ltar/ 'jal byed shes pa dang*/ gzhal bya dag bden stong mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa nyid kyi sgo nas ye shes de rnams kyis spang bya de dag rim gyis 'joms par byed pa'i phyir/ klan ka ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam chung rim nas bden 'dzin che rim gyis spong ba mi 'thad par thal/ sgom lam che rim gyis bden 'dzin che rim nas spong pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ dper na/ dgra stobs ldan 'dul ba la gnyen po yang stobs dang ldan dgos pa bzhin no zhe na/ lan ni skabs 'dir skyon de mi 'jug par thal/ 'dir spang gnyen gyi rim pa de ni gos la chags pa'i dri ma che rim nas sel ba dang mtshungs kyi/ snga ma dang dpe mtshungs pa ma yin pa'o/ /gtso bo'i dbang du byas na theg chen gyis sgom lam sa gnyis pa nas bcu ba'i bar la 'jog kyang*/ sa dang por yang sgom lam yod de/ theg chen sgo 'byed las/ sa dang po ni bskal pa la sogs pa'i yun gyis rdzogs dgos pas de'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sgom lam yod par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sa dang po na sgom lam mnyam gzhag ye shes yod par ma zad/ rjes thob ye shes kyang yod de/ rnam bshad las/ mos pa sgom lam de ma dag sa bdun na yod par bshad pa'i rigs pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ sa dang po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sgom lam yod de/ 'grel chen las/

sa dang po'i skad cig ma dang po ni mthong ba'i lam yin no/ /skad cig ma gnyis pa nas rdo rje lta bur brjod pa'i bar chad med pa'i lam gang las de ma thag sangs rgyas kyi sa kun tu 'od byed pa'i bar 'di dag thams cad ni sgom pa'i lam yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// //

༄༅/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsum pa gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa la/ skabs 'dir gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ gzhung don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ lam shes pa bshad zin pa'i 'og tu gzhi shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam shes rgyud la skye ba mi rtag sogs bcu drug yongs su shes pa'i sgo nas gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyams su len dgos shing med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par lam legs par yongs su shes pa med pas thams cad shes pa nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhung don bshad pa la/ dngos dang*/ mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'bras yum la nye ring gi lam bshad pa/ gzhi shes sbyor ba bshad pa/ sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras su bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ nye ring gi rgyu mtshan/ rgyu mtshan de nyid sgrub pa/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min/ /zhes pa nas/ shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ ngag don ni/ 'dir bstan gzhi shes pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos can/ khyod sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud pa nye bar 'dod pa yin te/ dus gsum gyi chos rnams bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du shes rab kyis zin pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ tshu rol 'khor ba'i mtha' dang pha rol zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis la gnas pa ma yin te/ mthar gnyis 'gog byed kyi lam yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ mtha' de dag gi bar na yang don dam par gnas pa ma yin te/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir bstan srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha'i khyad par yod de/

srid mtha' ni gzhi kun rdzob la bltos pa'i srid mtha' te 'khor ba yin la/ zhi mtha' ni de la bltos pa'i zhi mtha' te chad pa'i myang 'das la byed pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags chos can/ 'dir bstan srid mtha' la mi gnas te/ las nyon gyi dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba mi len pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba len pa yin te/ der skye ba len pa'i rgyu brtse ba snying rje sogs thabs shes rab khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'dir bstan zhi mtha' la yang mi gnas te/ las nyon chad tsam gyi myang 'das thob byar don du mi gnyer ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ de lta bu'i myang 'das don du mi gnyer te/ sems can gyi don du 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba bzhes nas don mdzad cing sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa nye ring gi rgyu mtshan sgrub pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /zhes pa nas/ yang dag nye ba nyid du bshad/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ nyan rang 'phags pa chos can/ gzhi shes pa'i sher phyin de ni khyod la ring ba yin te/ khyod gzhi bden pa'i mtshan mar dmigs pa ste bzung ba'i sgo nas 'bras yum bskyed pa'i thabs ma yin pas zin pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags chos can/ shes phyin de ni khyod la yang dag par nye ba nyid du bshad de/ 'bras yum bskyed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa stong nyid rtogs pa yis zin pa'i phyir/ de ni bden 'dzin yod pa tsam min gyi/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings ma bcings kyi dbang gis yin te/ skabs gsum pa'i lugs 'dir nyan rang la stong nyid rtogs pa med pas bden 'dzin gyis bcings par 'dod cing*/ /byang 'phags rnams kyis stong nyid rtogs myong bas des ma bcings pa'i phyir/ bden 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i don yang yod de/ stong nyid rtogs ma myong zhing bden zhen las re zhig 'da' mi nus pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa la/

gzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen dang*/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen dang*/ mjug bsdu ba bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i phyogs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ gzhi shes bya ji lta bas bsdus pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid dang*/ ji snyed pas bsdus pa 'das pa la sogs pa'i dus gsum du gtogs pa'i chos rnams dang*/ lam sbyin pa dang tshul khrims sogs byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams la bden zhen gyis spyod pa'i 'du shes kyis bcings pa'i lam chos can/ byang chub sems dpa' rigs nges pa de'i lam gyi gol sa'i mi mthun phyogs yin te/ 'bras bur sher phyin sgrub pa'i ring lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /ces pa nas/ de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gogs pas/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ lam sbyin pa la sogs pa la bden zhen gyi ngar 'dzin med pa la rang nyid gnas shing*/ gzhan dag de la sbyor bar byed pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi bden med du mngon gsum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de ni chos can/ gzhi lam la bden par chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pa yin te/ chags pa de'i gnyen po khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes la mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi tha snyad mdzad pa ni bden 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i byang sems kyi lam la bltos nas yin gyi/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes de mi mthun phyogs dngos ma yin te/ mthun phyogs khyad par can yin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags lam min pa'i phyir ro/ /skabs gsum pa 'dir mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes la bden 'dzin gyis bcings pas khyad par bstan pa ni dgos pa'i dbang gis yin gyi/ de kho na ltar 'dod dgos pa'i nges pa ni med de/

skabs gzhan dang khyad par du rigs kyi skabs su theg dman 'phags pa la stong nyid rtogs myong yod par bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin spang gnyen bshad pa la/ chags pa'i ngo bo/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i gnyen po 'phros don bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ /rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra/ /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ rgyal ba la sogs pa'i 'bras bu la bden par chags pa phra mos bcings bzhin du de la phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa chos can/ byang sems lam gyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ de'i gol sa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ chos rnams kyi lam gnas lugs mthar thug de ni chos can/ zab pa nyid yin te/ /bden par grub pa'i rang bzhin gyis dben pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni/ /shes pas chags pa spong ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin bden stong du gcig par ni mngon sum du shes pa'i byang 'phags kyi ye shes chos can/ khyod kyis 'bras bu la bden par chags pa spong ba yin te/ de 'joms byed kyi gnyen po khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ /bzhi pa la/ zab pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis/ /de ni rtogs par dka' bar bshad/ /ces gsungs/ don dam pa'i bden pa de ni chos can/ zab mo rtogs par dka' bar bshad de/ don dam dpyod byed ci rigs shes kyis rtogs par bya ba yin gyi gzugs sgra mthong ba la sogs pa'i tha snyad pa'i tshad mas khyod mthong ba bkab pa yis te de'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ don dam bden pa de ni chos can/ tha snyad pa'i blos rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ blo de bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa de'i phyir/

der thal/ khyod gzugs la sogs pa kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin par mi shes pa'i phyir ram/ gzugs sogs ltar mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la/ /zhes pa nas/ /ji skad bshad pa 'dir shes bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ kun shes bzhi shes nyid kyi lugs la te skabs su mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang*/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes dag gi rnam par dbye ba ma lus pa yum gyi mdo las ji skad bshad pa de rnams 'dir yang dngos shugs ci rigs kyi sgo nas bshad par shes par bya ste/ sngar bshad pa de ltar shes par bya dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhi shes sbyor ba 'chad pa la/ dbye ba dang*/ rang bzhin bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*/ zhes pa nas/ snang ba rnam bdun shes byed do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba de la bcu yod de/ yul gyi sgo nas bzhi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gsum/ byed las kyi sgo nas cha gnyis/ dpe'i sgo nas gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yul gyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ khyad gzhi gzugs sogs la bden par zhen pa dang*/ khyad chos de mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs dang*/ de yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pa dang rab rdzogs pa dang*/ de la bden par chags pa med nyid la bden par spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo nas gsum yod de/ bya ba la bden zhen 'gog pa mi 'gyur ba dang*/ byed pa po la bden zhen 'gog pa byed po med pa nyid dang*/ 'bras bu la bden zhen 'gog pa bya dka' ba rnam pa gsum gyi sbyor ba dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ bya dka' ba gsum yod de/ ched du bya dka' ba/ sbyor ba bya dka' ba/ las bya dka' ba dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa byed las kyi sgo nas gnyis yod de/ rigs can gsum gyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin 'bras bu thob pas 'bras bu yod par 'dod pa'i sbyor ba de dang ni/

phan yon dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan la rag las pa med pa gang yin pa'i spyod pa dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba shes byed dpe'i sgo nas gcig yod de/ snang ba rnam pa bdun du shes par byed pa'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba gcig yod pa'i phyir/ snang ba rnam bdun yod de/ rmi lam sgyu ma smig sgyu sgra brnyan gzugs bsnyan dri za'i grong khyer sprul pa'i dpe bdun gyis/ phyi nang gi chos rnams bden par med kyang rten 'brel gyi snang ba tsam du sgrub tshul rnam pa bdun yod pa'i phyir/ de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang*/ zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi yon tan gyi rten du rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi khyad par yod de/ gang la dmigs na nyon mongs skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyogs gzugs sgra sogs yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs la/ gang la dmigs nas bsgoms pas rtogs pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba gzugs sogs mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong ba dang bdag med pa lta bu yon tan gyi rten du rdzogs par 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rang bzhin ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa/ /rnam bzhi de yi mnyam pa nyid/ /ces gsungs/ don ni/ /shes bya chos can/ 'dir sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba de yi mnyam nyid de la rnam pa bzhi yod de/ yul gzugs la sogs pa'i ngo bo dang mtshan ma dang dbye ba dang yul can la bden par rlom pa med pa'i sbyor ba bzhi rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba dang*/ de'i mnyam nyid kyi khyad par yod de/ spyir theg dman kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes rnams dang po yin zhing*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes rnams phyi ma yin la/ gzhung gnyis ka'i dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas na de 'dra ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam la byed pa'i phyir/

gsum pa sbyor ba bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa la/ skad cig ma mdor bstan pa dang*/ rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ /zhes pa nas/ kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ byang sems mthong lam ba'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi po so so la dmigs nas chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ chos dang rjes su shes pa'i mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug gi bdag nyid 'di chos can/ kun shes tshul la mthong ba'i lam yin te/ 'da' byed kyi theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dis 'da' bya 'da' byed gnyis kyi nang nas 'da' byed kyi mthong lam bstan pa yin la/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de gnas nas 'da' byed dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam de shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bya'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems kyis thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i don du stong nyid gtso bor bsgom dgos shing*/ nyan rang gi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa'i ched du gang zag gi bdag med zhar byung ngam phal pa'i tshul gyis sgom par byed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ so sor bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ /zhes pa nas/ shes pa skye ba med pa ni/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pas bsdus pa'i gzugs tshor sogs mi rtag pa chos can/ don dam par rtag pa yang min mi rtag pa yang ma yin te/ don dam par rtag mi rtag gnyis ka dang bral ba'i phyir te/ don dam par ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ rtags 'di 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar dgos te/ bden bzhi don dam par med par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/

/sdug bden gyi rnam pa phyi ma gsum chos can/ don dam par rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa dang*/ don gzhan gyis stong pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ rang dbang ba'i bdag gi ngo bo ma grub don dam par ma skyes pa dang ma 'gag pa la sogs kyis kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba min te/ rim pa bzhin don dam par sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal ma yin pa dang bral ba'i phyir dang*/ stong mi stong dang*/ bdag dang bdag med pa dang yang bral ba'i phyir te/ mthong lam sdug bsngal shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par rtogs pa'i phyir/ las sred kyis bsdus pa'i kun 'byung gi rnam pa 'di chos can/ don dam par ma grub pa nam mkha' dang 'dra ba dang*/ chags sogs kyi sred pa don dam par grub pa spangs pa dang*/ don dam par yongs su 'dzin pa las grol ba dang*/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis brjod du med pa yin te/ rim pa bzhin sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa dang*/ kun 'byung yin min dang*/ rab skye yin min dang*/ rkyen dang rkyen min rnams su don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir te/ kun 'byung shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ 'gog bden 'di'i don sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bral pa chos can don dam par ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na tshig tu brjod pa yi sgo nas gzhan rgyud la don dam par sbyin du med pa dang*/ dmigs pa don dam par med par byed pa dang*/ rtag chad las 'das shing rang bzhin gyis shin tu rnam pa dag pa dang*/ gnod pa'i nad thams cad mi 'byung pa'i yon tan ldan pa yin te/ rim pa bzhin 'gog pa yin min dang*/ zhi ba yin min dang*/ gya nom yin min dang*/ nges 'byung yin min rnams su don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir te/ 'gog pa shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i lam bden chos can/

ngan song gsum chad pa dang*/ rgyun zhugs sogs kyi 'bras bu ni mngon du bya ba la rnam par mi rtog pa nyid dang*/ don dam par grub pa'i mtshan ma dag dang ma 'brel ba dang brjod bya'i dngos po dang brjod byed kyi ming so so ba dang gnyis po la gnyis snang dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis shes pa skye ba med pa ni yin te/ rim pa bzhin lam dang lam ma yin pa dang*/ rig pa dang rig pa ma yin pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang sgrub pa ma yin pa dang*/ nges 'byin dang nges 'byin ma yin par don dam par ma grub pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod kyis de ltar don dam par ma grub par gnyis snang nub pa'i tshul kyis rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa don bsdu tshul ni/ kun shes nyid kyi skad cig ma/ /zhes gsungs/ don ni/ sngar bshad pa'i kun shes nyid kyi shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug chos can/ byang sems kyi mthong lam yin te/ de'i bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs su mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam 'chad rigs pa las/ de mi ston par stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam ston pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ skyon med de/ 'dir zin byed 'da' byed kyi mthong lam dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i de 'dra ba'i 'da' bya'i mthong lam bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad las/ 'dis nyan thos rang rgyud kyi mthong lam dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la bsgom par bya ba shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bar bya ba'i mthong lam gnyis ka bsdus nas bstan pa'i yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir mthong lam bstan pa'i mjug de ma thag mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam dngos su ston pa'i gzhung zhig 'byung rigs pa las mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/

de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de byang chub sems dpas gnas nas 'da' ba'i lam du ston mi rigs pas ma bstan la/ shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba'i lam du ston mi dgos pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ sngar de 'dra ba'i mthong lam de shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' ba'i lam bstan pa la brten nas/ de'i rigs rgyun du gyur pa'i sgom lam yang de 'dra ba'i lam du gnas pas ma bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ni/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang*/ /zhes pa nas/ rdzogs par yongs su bstan pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs*/ don ni/ rtsa ba ltar na de ltar mkhyen gsum rgyas par bstan nas/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor yum 'di ni chos gang yang thob par byed pa ma yin/ zhes sogs gzhi shes kyi mjug bsdur ston pa'i tshig bcu dgu po 'di dang*/ yang rab 'byor de ltar khams gsum las 'da' bar byed pa ma yin zhes sogs lam shes kyi mjug bsdu pa'i tshig 'di dang*/ yang rab 'byor yum 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ster bar byed pa'am 'phrog par byed pa ma yin zhes sogs rnam mkhyen gyi mjug bsdu ba'i tshig 'di yin te mdo tshig rnam pa gsum po 'di ni chos can/ sngar mkhyen gsum brjod byar byas pa'i gnas skabs gsum po dag gi mjug rdzogs par yongs su bstan pa yin te/ de rnams kyi mjug sdud rdzogs par ston pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'grel ba las rnam mkhyen gyi mjug sdud thog mar byas nas 'chad de/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di dang*/ /lam shes pa nyid 'di dang*/ /thams cad shes pa nyid 'di ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi dgongs pa mi 'gal te/ rtsa ba ltar bshad pa ni yum bar ma'i dbang du byas la/ 'grel par bshad pa de nyid brgyad stong pa'i mjug sdud ston tshul yin pa'i phyir/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum po la tshig rgyas bsdus yod kyang don 'dra ste/
